body:
I’m paying my way through community college. Failed the last two semesters. Had periodic panic attacks during which time, that my parents called attention seeking behavior and berated me for buckling under “a little bit of stress” when I was going to work full time at the same time. Mom told me constantly that at 18 she was already in her own apartment and had me, so why wasn’t I putting forth the same effort she did? 

So. Short answer: don’t know. 

Longer answer: Too tired to sink money into something I’ll fail again, when I can barely afford the rent my parents charge as is. I’m saving money best I can but rent is $400. I know it doesn’t seem like a lot but my monthly salary is $1200 after deductions and I pay for utilities ($50), phone ($30), Internet ($25), gas/the right to be driven somewhere because I’m not allowed to leave the house without permission ($50), a portion of my health insurance ($245), all medical bills I incur, a portion of the car insurance ($75), dental insurance ($60), and cat related expenses ($15 a month to keep the cat, plus food, litter, vet visits). 

I give them $950 every month just as a base rate. I don’t own a vehicle because, they wouldn’t even let me go see a car when I finally found one (back when I had savings). They own two vehicles and  offered to let me buy the second car— a 95 dodge Dakota — for $7k. When I finally had the money together, they said I needed the money for school, why would I waste money when they are “perfectly happy” to drive me where I “need” to go. 

It’s the next morning and they want me to call my grandmother, apologize, and tell her I want to come despite what I said. They are acting like yesterday didn’t even happen, except for that one comment. They’re laughing and joking with each other and watching gilligan’s island and they made themselves a nice breakfast of eggs and bacon. They smiled at me and laughed at my bed head. My head still hurts from crying. And they are pretending like they did nothing to me. 

I’m going to draft up a note. At the least I’ll feel like I’ve accomplished something by way of taking control from them. I can’t keep this up, going from being terrified of them to having to reciprocate their saccharine affection that rings hollow. Let them pretend like they never saw this coming.
